phrases.text: Outlook just went down around the world.
On the twelfth of November, email and Teams stopped for hours.
Why? Microsoft says some email servers failed their automatic health checks, and switched off.
Their work moved to the servers still running, until those were overloaded too. Like dominoes.
It wasn't a hack, and it wasn't extra traffic.
Email is fifty-five years old, and it can still fall over.
Did it hit you? Comment below, and subscribe for more.
